name: Goka (Shimane, Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Goka village emblem in white: an outlined ring crossed by a stylised arrow pointing to the fly.
history: Flag of the former village of Goka in Shimane Prefecture, dissolved on 2004-10-01. The municipal emblem was adopted in 1979.

features.role: Goka village emblem — an outlined ring crossed by a stylised arrow pointing to the fly
